Scope: Runtime combat/resource/cost rules with planned operations; not a native UI or full queue playthrough
Assumptions: 70% starting HP with at most one basic heal per battle
ordinary drops use fixed seeds and actual quotas/pity
garden waiting is charged separately, without free input income
basic armor retained; optional first-clear armor not required
exploration pauses for sampled ordinary encounters; farming costs are charged separately
planned actions count is not measured UI clicks or return visits
HP is an isolated 70% battle fixture, not persistent HP across encounters
input income is online; no offline income is added
manual realm 10 breakthrough requires all five first clears
extra preparation farming is charged without reducing later exploration budgets, which overestimates inputs
StressScope: Zero weighted dungeon material rewards; configured guarantees/pity remain, fishing uses its ordinary seeded rule; optional counter farming stops after ten sampled opportunities
